rules: Corporate identity, services, solutions and company content belong on www.skunkworks.africa.
Product, collection, cart, account and checkout routes belong on store.skunkworks.africa.
Training catalogues, labs, credentials and learner services belong on www.skunkworksacademy.com or its governed Academy subdomains.
Do not duplicate product detail pages on the corporate site.
Do not duplicate Academy course detail pages on the corporate site.
All commerce CTAs from www must resolve to store.skunkworks.africa.
All learning CTAs from www must resolve to www.skunkworksacademy.com or a canonical Academy property.
Every indexable www page must emit a self-referencing canonical URL.
Navigation order is Solutions, Services, Store, Academy, Company.
Mobile navigation must expose the same primary destinations as desktop navigation.
